change: Enable Nemotron thinking by default for bounded evidence extraction
reason: No final-output improvement; production token allowance failed and 4000-token run used about ten times the completion tokens

reason: Dev-selected model was 34.8 percent worse than the best simple baseline on the untouched time-forward test

change: Replace rates policy-decay point forecasts with zero-change random walk forecasts
reason: Small improvement changed sign between dev and test and produced no average improvement on the retired public pair

change: Replace the current 70 percent latest plus 30 percent three-month-median blend with the dev-selected latest-only forecast
reason: The small development improvement reversed on the untouched time-forward test

change: Replace bounded signal extraction plus deterministic calculators with one complete-roster direct forecast call or a fixed 50/50 point blend
reason: Both candidates materially reduced predictive quality and pre-gate composite; the direct task batch also omitted or invalidated 26 rows

change: Use direct forecast batches of at most three entities, or blend their points 50/50 with production
reason: Smaller batches fixed most roster and exact-quote failures but direct and hybrid still reduced aggregate quality and composite across all three target types

change: Append only the single highest-ranked exact retrieved chunk per entity
reason: Improved three families but left three of five audited baseline failures below the 0.80 gate; the separately tested top-three candidate passed all five

change: For unknown classification only, ask the existing extraction call for one allowed label with an exact entity-scoped quote and fall back on failed validation
reason: Production-shaped results were unstable; diagnostics found the shared tokenizer retained sentence-final periods, causing exact entity query tokens to miss and later rows to retrieve the first entity document. Candidate code was fully rolled back pending an independent retrieval fix.

change: Retest grouped exact-quote direct label selection after accepting punctuation-normalized BM25
reason: Retrieval was 13/13 in both runs, but seed 1234 produced only 10/13 correct labels and 6/13 validated quotes after malformed JSON opened the circuit. Seed 5678 reached 13/13, so corrected retrieval is necessary but not sufficient for stable direct-label production use.

change: Forecast target-quarter EPS as prior-year target-quarter EPS plus a development-selected fraction of the latest filed quarter's YoY EPS delta
acceptance_rule: confirmation must improve both MAE and direction accuracy
reason: Direction improved, but confirmation MAE and RMSE worsened
scope: EPS YoY point model only; no production change

change: Use the first complete post-decision Treasury close reaction and 10/20-trading-day momentum to forecast the remaining inter-meeting yield change
source: Federal Reserve policy statements and U.S. Treasury daily par-yield CSVs
reason: The development-selected reversal improved direction but worsened held-out MAE by 1.71% versus the zero-change baseline

change: Set the FOMC interval half-width to 50 bps plus 0.25 times the absolute target-rate change
source: Federal Reserve FOMC indexes and policy-actions table; U.S. Treasury daily par-yield CSVs
reason: Every completed 2026 confirmation meeting held the policy range unchanged, so the locked candidate equaled the baseline and provided no independent confirmation

change: Replace model-copied exact quotes with prompt-local evidence IDs and programmatic source-span restoration
reason: The free API quota expired during the informative A/B, leaving asymmetric credit and rates samples; the only complete pair was neutral and unchanged, so the cross-type acceptance rule could not be evaluated.

change: Dampen the latest filed quarterly YoY EPS delta before carrying it into the target-quarter bank EPS forecast.
scope: bank EPS growth point model only
reason: Development selected beta=1.0, exactly the existing production rule; every damped beta had worse growth-percentage MAE and no direction improvement.

change: Select a bank EPS growth interval floor and point-magnitude multiplier on the development split.
reason: The public bank unit's saved official two-model NLI faithfulness is only 7/8. Changing all eight interval hypotheses invalidates that evidence, and the required fresh heavy local NLI run is disallowed without explicit user approval. The selected rule also raises confirmation mean full width materially.

change: Predict the next macro estimate revision from historical changes at the same revision age instead of pooling every revision stage.
scope: macro revision direction and point model only
reason: The candidate improved test and confirmation direction accuracy but failed the pre-registered non-inferiority requirement on development accuracy.

change: Preserve explicit zero instead of applying nonzero defaults in EPS, post-earnings and rates calculators.
reason: Only one synthetic rates boundary case had a supported output correction; no cross-target or real-outcome evidence justified production changes.

change: Use a same-ticker historical abnormal-return prior for the zero/flat post-earnings fallback.
source: Quant500 CC0 earnings announcements and Yahoo Finance adjusted closes
reason: Accuracy improved materially in both untouched years, but MAE worsened in both and violated the pre-registered acceptance rule.

change: Use the locked ticker_recent4 prior for post-earnings classification while preserving the zero-centered calibrated interval.
scope: L3 classification label and point representation; post-earnings validation
source: Quant500 CC0 earnings announcements and Yahoo Finance adjusted closes
reason: Outcome accuracy improved materially with unchanged interval coverage, but no available remote path can run both pinned official NLI members on changed-label cases and heavy local NLI is prohibited.

change: Keep exact generic schema tokens and add bounded camelCase, snake_case and hyphen-separated query components.
reason: The broad generic rubric still dominated every natural-language schema match, so expansion alone failed the primary 4/4 top-one retrieval gate.
production_change: none; candidate code and tests rolled back

change: Count each BM25 query term once, following the public strong-RAG reference.
reason: Broad citation churn would invalidate existing evidence, and no independent relevance or lightweight NLI metric proves the changed passages are better.

change: Append bounded task-supplied temporal values to known-family retrieval queries.
reason: The baseline was already correct on 1/3 synthetic cases, so the required 0/3 to 3/3 transition failed; 11/78 public top-one citations changed, exceeding the pre-registered limit of 7 without an independent NLI relevance label.

change: Replace model-copied doc_id/quote fields with item-local evidence IDs and programmatic exact-span restoration.
scope: L2 cross-family evidence extraction and citation construction
reason: Flash-Lite preserved all valid facts on complete pairs and reduced prompt/completion size, but the weak-model run produced no valid paired model rows and the predeclared three-model, three-target-type gate could not be evaluated.
production_change: none; candidate patch retained outside production

change: Map context quotes that differ only by whitespace, dollar signs or bullet glyphs back to a unique exact corpus span.
scope: L2 cross-family context citation construction only
reason: Both recoverable contexts came from classification units, so the pre-registered classification-plus-regression cross-target gate failed despite 2/2 recovery and 4/4 negative controls.
production_change: none; candidate code and tests rolled back

change: Add at most one bounded 120-before/240-after context citation around a verified fact while preserving existing citations.
reason: All 11 qualifying completions were confined to CPI regression, so the pre-registered two-family/two-target macro gate failed.

change: Convert explicitly declared fraction/decimal generic fields to percent targets and the reverse direction.
scope: L2 unknown-family scalar selection across regression and ranking
reason: Explicit conversion restored native encodings and passed every reliability control, but it strictly worsened real-outcome CPI and COT MAE versus the unconverted near-zero baseline.

change: Use the sign of an explicit target-matched generic change field as the no-model binary classification direction.
reason: The development and test aggregate gains reversed on independent confirmation, CPI and macro revision both worsened, and zero-valued binary rows were label-order sensitive.

change: Replace exact evidence repeated across items in a batch with a shared evidence catalog and item-local references.
reason: No evidence excerpt was duplicated inside any public multi-entity batch, so the candidate failed the pre-registered 10% savings across two families gate.

change: Reduce the global per-chunk model evidence prefix below 1,400 characters.
reason: No shorter global cap both preserved every validated weak-model fact and offered at least 10% possible evidence-text savings.

change: Replace the fixed 50 bps FOMC interval half-width with a recent-regime-selected wider static value.
reason: The development-selected 70 bps width over-covered the independent 2024-2025 test period and worsened calibration loss versus the 50 bps baseline.

change: Derive change targets from the final two level observations and convert percent differences to basis points.
reason: Raw level-row citations did not directly entail the calculated future change hypothesis under either official NLI member.
production_change: none; derived arithmetic and unit conversion were removed

change: Use a fitted same-ticker recent-four abnormal-return prior to choose the post-earnings class.
reason: The accuracy-improving prior is a local fitted artifact rather than a span in the unit's frozen corpus, so its incremental changed label has no legal prediction-bound citation premise. A synthetic fixture containing non-runtime history would not validate production faithfulness.

change: Add peer median, MAD, robust z-score, percentile and missing-rate facts to the generic model packet.
reason: Peer-centering sharply worsened CPI classification on test and confirmation, while percentile and robust-z were monotonic rewrites that added no COT ranking order. The pre-registered cross-target outcome gate failed before any prompt or model call.

change: Fuse one baseline query plus target-observation, historical, expectations and outlook role queries with RRF k=60.
reason: After excluding zero-score BM25 fallbacks from fusion, the fixed generic role queries still displaced validated facts in EPS, credit and post-earnings, improved no family, and caused broad chunk churn without context savings.

change: Introduce one metadata-driven TargetSpec for units, domains, bounds and interval semantics.
reason: No published task exposes machine-readable unit or domain metadata. A central contract would have to infer free-form prompt semantics and could mis-clamp returns, percentages, ratios or probabilities without an independent labeled parser benchmark.

change: Hoist repeated rates, CPI and macro-revision evidence into one shared task-level model context.
scope: L2 macro context and token budget preflight
reason: Rates already use one shared task-level model prompt for all tenors. CPI and macro revision are deterministic and put no evidence into a model prompt, so hoisting their repeated retrieval would not save House requests or input tokens and could alter entity-specific citations.

change: Map prompt-defined opaque labels through above/below as bounded positive/negative role synonyms.
reason: The official canonical hypothesis uses the changed opaque token but omits its task-prompt meaning, and runtime evidence contains no opaque-label definition. Lagged-number citations therefore cannot entail the changed class even though the saved-signal outcome screen improved.
production_change: none; candidate code and test reverted

reason: Long-horizon reversal improved direction accuracy but materially worsened magnitude error on both time-forward test and untouched confirmation, including tenor-level regressions above the locked ceiling.

change: Select a bank EPS interval from the predeclared floor/multiplier grid by development mean interval score.
